waypoints.name: Wild Hair Crack start (Himmelhorn-Ottohorn col area)

pitch_detail.notes: Twin crack systems; the right-hand crack (the FA line) is preferred; anchor established at top.
The signature 12-inch-wide vertical crack with some face holds; protection is sparse for the first ~20 ft then improves. 4-star pitch.
Easy scrambling toward the false summit; belay at a notch just below it. Avoid the gully to the left for a cleaner finish.
Exposed ridge scramble to the summit block with airy low-5th moves. Length derived from total route length (136 m) minus the first three pitches (125 m); not independently sourced per-pitch.
